statement: Top of the Refinery shows time until the next combustion cycle when you gain your next batch of salts from refining
Left-hand switches select which combustions run in the next refining cycle and stay active until manually turned off
Fuel Components show materials needed per cycle and how many you hold in storage; first Redox Salt costs 580 Spore Caps and 290 Copper Ore ranked up (base 10 and 5)
Power Bar shows salts refined and max cap; fill it to 100% then click Refine to rank up the salt and raise multipliers
Fuel Time is materials in storage chest divided by cost per cycle; example shows almost 40 days of refining
Auto Refine sets how often the machine clicks refine automatically with options 0% 10% 25% 50% 75% or 90%
Set auto refine to 0% so it never clicks Refine for you if you want to rank up that salt
Clicking the wrench cycles how many salts you want before it automatically refines; he accidentally clicked it and lost 170000 salts
View Rank button at top changes the display to show the rank of the current refining cycle
Rank number is only a measurement but 3 multipliers increase with rank; at rank 15 component cost is 58x the base 10 giving 580
Power Cap multiplier rises as you gain salts requiring more before you can complete the next rank up
Power per Cycle multiplier grows slower than component cost so higher ranks cost more materials per salt gained
Each salt must be ranked up individually by completing its power cycles
Unlocking new salts costs an amount of the previous salt and each fuel component requires a set amount of salts
Keep Redox Salt refining rank higher than Explosive Salt so Explosive production continues at a constant pace
Output Box is where the refinery deposits salts
Salts in output can be used in next cycles or the Construction Workbench but must be deposited to storage to be used for crafting
Salts in the storage chest can be used by the Refinery or the Construction Workbench as well
Base combustion cycle timer is 15 minutes while the synthesis cycle is 1 hour
Synthesis materials are on a 1 hour timer versus needing 4x as much for the combustion cycle
Alchemy vial Red Malt increases base refining cycle speed; decent bonus as long as you have enough Red Salts to spend
Third Salt Lick bonus increases refining speed by up to 20% per cycle
Maxing the Salt Lick refining speed bonus costs quite a lot of Explosive Salts
World 3 Merit Shop bonus Refinery Salt Costs Don't Scale Beyond the Power Output is very important; 5 tiers starting from Explosive Salt onward
The merit is not needed for Redox Salt since it applies from Explosive Salt and beyond
Explosive example: without merit 18x needs 36 Redox for 12 Explosive; with merit 12x needs 24 Redox for 12 Explosive
World 4 Laboratory Gilded Cyclical Tubing allows refining 3x faster
With the tubing combustion base goes from 15 to 5 minutes and synthesis from 1 hour to 20 minutes per cycle
Squire's Refinery Throttle at 100 talent points triggers 15 refinery cycles automatically
Refinery Throttle still costs materials but is a great way to get more salts when stocking up
Refinery Throttle can be used every 20 hours
At 160 talent points Refinery Throttle triggers 23 refinery cycles instead of 15
